translation: Her family sacrificed as he said, and she was cured. At first I found this strange, and then thought of the matter of the two ghosts in the gaohuang of Duke Jing of Jin; when vacuity and fatigue are extreme, ghosts take advantage of the vacuity to dwell there. This woman perhaps also had fatigue of the heart with vacuity and damage, and so a ghost dwelt in her.
